name: Snap Taxi
tagline: Rider and driver apps for an Uzbek taxi service — live tracking, chat and a taximeter
role: Rider and driver apps by the Softwhere team (React Native)

scenes.title: Rider app: pick a class, see the fare
scenes.body: Nearby cars and a pickup pin; each class is priced from the route distance.

scenes.title: Live driver tracking and chat
scenes.body: The driver's car refreshes on the map every 5 s; chat, call or tap “I'm coming out”.

scenes.title: Driver app: orders in real time
scenes.body: Orders arrive over Laravel Echo sockets with fare, commission, pickup and rider note; 10 seconds to accept.

scenes.title: A taximeter built into every trip
scenes.body: Waiting turns paid after three free minutes; a trip timer and background GPS track the ride.
